text:
lex_marketing: Quick sync on CedarEdge customer story — need final quote + legal signoff before embargo next Wed (03/31). Can everyone confirm availability for a 15m review?
priya_pm: I can do 3/29 10:30am PT or 3/30 2pm PT. Need to lock quote lines and hero metrics.
maya_cs: 3/29 10:30 works for CedarEdge stakeholder (Jordan). I'll confirm calendar invite.
samir_legal: Heads-up: we'll need written permission for the throughput numbers and the logo. Also prefer avoiding naming their internal model tuning parameters.
lex_marketing: Noted. For metrics, proposed copy options: 
• Option A: "Cut inference cost by ~3x with Redwood batching and KV cache"
• Option B: "Latency reduced to 45ms p50 in production"
Which is truer to what CedarEdge approved in interview?
maya_cs: Jordan verbally approved Option A in the call but asked us to avoid exact multiplier if it isn't audited. He said "substantially lower cost" would be safer.
priya_pm: Ok — new suggested hero: "Significantly lower inference cost and faster latency in production". We'll include a short footnote with run conditions.
chris_growth: For routing: once published, set inbound form to tag leads source=cedaredge-case and region=NA. AEs in SF team should get priority alerts. I'll update the playbook.
lex_marketing: @samir_legal can you draft a one-paragraph redline for the quote and permission checklist we can send to Jordan? We want this: permission for quote, permission for logo, embargo until 03/31 08:00AM PT, and approval of the short technical blurb.
samir_legal: Draft below — please review then I will send to customer.
```
Legal approval checklist for CedarEdge customer story:
1) Written confirmation of customer quote (exact wording to be approved)
2) Written permission to use CedarEdge name and logo in marketing assets
3) Confirmation of embargo date/time: 2026-03-31 08:00AM PT
4) Redaction request: CedarEdge retains right to remove any sensitive numbers or internal parameter names
```
lex_marketing: Perfect. Maya — can you run this by Jordan after the 3/29 review?
maya_cs: Yes — I'll get the signed reply and upload to the asset folder.
priya_pm: Also need to confirm screenshots: CedarEdge asked to remove hostnames and internal IDs. We'll scrub PII.
lex_marketing: Good catch. Once legal signs off and we have the written quote, I'll finish the draft and circulate for product/PM quick review.
launch-bot: Scheduled reminder created: "CedarEdge case final review" on 2026-03-29T17:30:00Z (calendar invite sent).
chris_growth: After publish, please enable the webinar follow-up campaign: 1) send 2-email drip to leads tagged cedar-edge; 2) route high-fit leads (>=75 score) to AE inbox with note: "Saw CedarEdge case — possible Redwood use".
lex_marketing: Will do. Any objections to including a short customer quote in the webinar slide deck (with embargo note)?
samir_legal: Fine as long as it's the approved wording and we have explicit consent for slide reuse.
maya_cs: Jordan's fine with slides once he approves the final quote. I'll attach the signed permission to the thread when I get it.
priya_pm: Timeline:
• 3/29 10:30am PT — internal review with Jordan
• 3/30 — legal send final permission email if any edits
• 3/31 08:00AM PT — embargo lifts, publish case + social + webinar assets
lex_marketing: Thanks team — I'll update the composer doc and add a pre-publish checklist. If anyone sees blocking items, flag here. :thumbsup:
maya_cs: Uploaded the transcript excerpt and screenshot redaction notes to the shared folder (link: https://drive.redwood/co/cedaredge).
lex_marketing: Received. Closing loop after legal confirmation.
